subject: Insurance
title: Virgin Birth Insurance
description: A 60-second lesson on Virgin Birth Insurance.

hook.text: Three women in the UK bought virgin birth insurance to cover the cost of raising Jesus if he were reborn through them.

buildup.text: The policies cost £100 each and promised £1 million per buyer to cover child-rearing expenses for a divine child.

discovery.text: The Catholic Church protested, calling the policies blasphemous. The insurer cancelled them to avoid controversy.

twist.text: The cancellation proved that even novelty insurance faces cultural and religious limits.

climax.text: Insurance can quantify almost any risk—but some risks offend beliefs in ways that override the market.

punchline.text: £100 for virgin birth coverage. The Church shut it down.

quiz.question: Why was virgin birth insurance cancelled?
options: The Catholic Church protested it as blasphemous
